note:
R143b - discriminator for the R143 render relation: per title and family, the render id set P of each candidate render prefix / position
(`rendering/<fam>` and `fe<fam>`) against the thumbnail id set T at shifts k = -3 .. +3: |(P + k) & T| / |P|. A naming candidate is
discriminating only if shift 0 is complete (or near) and every other shift is clearly lower. Also: which render ids lack a thumbnail, which
thumbnail ids lack a render id, and the byte-identical thumbnail groups. Read-only. Usage: python r143b_thumbnail_render_shift.py <r53.json> <out.json>
